files.content:
# Waitlist (block: waitlist)

A launch waitlist: public join (idempotent per email) with a place in line, referral codes that move people up, admin list, stats, single use email invites (hashed tokens) in batches, and an optional gate so only invited addresses can register.

The code is in `app/blocks/waitlist/` and belongs to this project. Options go in `calm.config.js` under `blocks['waitlist']`; secrets go in `.env`.

## For AI agents

- Read `app/blocks/waitlist/index.js` first: the header lists every route and the rules of the line.
- Options live in `calm.config.js` under `blocks.waitlist`. `gate: true` makes registration invitation only.
- The place in line is computed, never stored: `score` (join number minus `referralBoost` per referral) then `seq`. Keep the index `{ status, score, seq }` if you change the query.
- Joining is idempotent per email: an existing entry is returned unchanged. Never let a second join change name, referrer or status.
- Invite tokens are stored as `hashToken(token)` only; the raw token exists only in the invite email. A new invite replaces the old token.
- The register gate is a `calm.guard` on `POST /auth/register` that checks and removes `inviteToken` from the body; the `beforeCreate` wrapper on the user service is the backstop for other sign-up paths (magic-link, OAuth). Keep both.
- Admin creates (`hasRole(ctx.user, 'admin')`) and trusted code (`{ system: true }`) are not gated, on purpose.
- `auth.registered` marks the entry `registered` and clears the token; that plus the unique user email makes invites single use.
- Referral counting is capped by `maxReferrals` in the update filter; do not move the cap to application code (races).
- The join route is public: keep `joinLimit` and leave `confirmationEmail` off unless you accept emails to unverified addresses.
- Use `app.ext.waitlist` (`join`, `invite`, `validInvite`, `positionOf`, `Entry`) from jobs and scripts.
- Events: waitlist.joined, waitlist.referred, waitlist.invited, waitlist.registered, waitlist.removed, security.invite_refused.

## Official documentation

- [OWASP Forgot Password Cheat Sheet (single use token handling)](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Forgot_Password_Cheat_Sheet.html)
- [OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet (account enumeration)](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authentication_Cheat_Sheet.html)
- [MongoDB unique indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-unique/)
- [MongoDB findOneAndUpdate](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.findOneAndUpdate/)
- [MongoDB aggregation $group](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group/)

## Usage

Join: POST /api/waitlist { email, name?, referralCode? } -> { status, position, waiting, referrals, referralCode, referralUrl } (201 new, 200 already on the list). Check: GET /api/waitlist/:referralCode.
Admins: GET /api/admin/waitlist?status=waiting|invited|registered|all&q=, GET /api/admin/waitlist/stats, POST /api/admin/waitlist/invite { count } or { ids }, POST /api/admin/waitlist/:id/invite, DELETE /api/admin/waitlist/:id.
Invites link to APP_URL/signup?invite=...&email=... (option signupUrl). With gate: true, POST /api/auth/register needs { ...user, inviteToken }.
Options (calm.config.js blocks.waitlist): gate, referralBoost, maxReferrals, inviteTtlDays, referralUrl, signupUrl, confirmationEmail, joinLimit, maxInviteBatch.

More: https://docs.calmapi.dev/blocks/waitlist
